title: First unpaid job and the Desdunes tour
summary: Dejan tells of being cheated of pay by Munson Hickman, then of the Desdunes tour through Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Iowa, Kansas and Nebraska, where Desdunes' father was popular but not the son.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Yeah, it was a tough bunch of them. It was pretty much. The first job that, I think it was about the first job I never got paid on, I played at the corner club. I don't mean the club, the club paid them the job, but this fella by the name of Munson Hickman, he had a job and we was all youngsters, you know, and he got the money in front. See, and he went and take another job, he sent us on that job so we go to collect our money because we played the dance, the man said, well we paid Hickman off already. So we never get our money. Of course I never did tell my dad, because my dad wouldn't have found him, you know. Not that my dad needed the money, but just for the principal of the thing, yeah. That's about the first job, the fellas would call that a ham in them days, you know, like when you're in the job, you say, we took a ham tonight. When we was with Desdun, I think the first, when we left, we were going on that tour, I think our first night, I think it was sixteen or twenty-two dollars we made that first night. But we did good all the way going. And Desdun said, y'all wait till y'all hit my home. I bet we'll make forty or fifty dollars a man. That's the way he's talking to the horse. We get in his home, I think we made about twenty-five cents a man. Yeah. But we was not broke, we all had money. Because we did good all the way through. Yeah, we did good. But you see, his father, I could understand his father in that territory was just like Claiborne William was around here on the other side of the river. You see, around Donovan and that poison girl all along that. Very popular, anywhere they played, that crowd, you see. But they didn't take the son like they did the father.
Desdun. Desdun, well around Omaha, Iowa, I mean around Nebraska, Iowa.
And we went up around Omaha.
Yeah, we went all the way to Omaha. We left here, we went to Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Iowa, and Kansas, and right on in Omaha.
